---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What problem does this solve?**
Describe the problem you are trying to solve, not the solution.

**Proposed solution**
Describe what you want to build.

**Which service would this change?**
(gateway / orchestrator / document / biometric / aml / risk / audit / notification / sdk / infra)

**Alternatives considered**
Any other approaches you thought about.

**Compliance impact**
Does this change affect KYC/AML compliance logic, data retention, audit logging, or PII handling? If yes, describe the impact.
